```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data("penguins")
```
```{r}
penguin_lm <- lm(body_mass  ~ flipper_len + species + sex + flipper_len:species, data = penguins)

summary(penguin_lm)
```
```{r}
tidy(penguin_lm)
```

```{r}
glance(penguin_lm)
```

```{r}
augment(penguin_lm)
```
